cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time
GOOD = open("/workspace/examples/input.json","rb").read()
def run(raw):
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=raw, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr, time.time()-t0
# pad to exactly 16 MiB
target = 16*1024*1024
pad = b" " * (target - len(GOOD))
raw = pad[:target//2] + GOOD + pad[target//2:]
assert len(raw) == target
rc,out,err,dt = run(raw)
print("exact 16MiB", rc, out[:60], len(err), "%.2fs"%dt)
raw2 = raw + b" "
rc,out,err,dt = run(raw2)
try: v=json.loads(out.decode())
except Exception: v=None
print("16MiB+1", rc, v, "%.2fs"%dt)
# huge integer
s = GOOD.decode().replace('"time": 0', '"time": ' + "9"*5000, 1)
rc,out,err,dt = run(s.encode())
try: v=json.loads(out.decode())
except Exception: v=None
print("5000-digit", rc, v, "%.2fs"%dt, len(err))
s = GOOD.decode().replace('"time": 0', '"time": ' + "9"*4000, 1)
rc,out,err,dt = run(s.encode())
try: v=json.loads(out.decode())
except Exception: v=None
print("4000-digit", rc, v, "%.2fs"%dt, len(err))
# whitespace-heavy valid input near 16MB: use indent
doc=json.loads(GOOD)
s=json.dumps(doc, indent=8)
print("indent8 size", len(s))
PYEOF
